answer: Bind each agent to a continuously signed power-telemetry stream from one metered physical machine; a rotating jury keeps an atlas of these signatures and runs correlation tests. Clones stacked on a single box share one energy draw, collapse into a tight cluster, and every bond behind them is slashed. A hollow identity emitting only a zephyr of idle traffic produces no real signature and earns nothing, unopened like a lotus in shade. Faking N agents needs N separate metered machines burning real electricity each epoch: a linear N-times hardware and power cost, never amortized.
